title: "Wallpaper" – U-2 radar-absorbing material panels and covered fuselage (p. 131)
description: Two black-and-white photographs captioned "'Wallpaper'." The upper photo shows stacked panels of radar-absorbing material printed with a fine grid pattern; the lower photo shows a U-2 fuselage section covered with the material in a workshop. The text describes the crash of the U-2 known as Article 341 in a remote area of Nevada.
